# Quantum Consulting

> French AI consulting and training firm, based in Paris. Two offerings for one
> audience — leaders of small and mid-sized companies: consulting, where we
> deploy AI into their processes, and training, where we make their teams
> autonomous.

The commercial entry point is the **free AI audit**: a process diagnosis that
identifies automatable tasks and quantifies the gain before any investment.

**Vendor-neutral by design.** We resell no vendor. The model is chosen task by
task — Claude, GPT-4o, Mistral, Llama — and deployment can be sovereign, hosted
in France, when confidentiality requires it.

## Consulting — "we do it for you"

- [AI Audit](https://quantum-agency.fr/en/audit-ia.html) — process mapping, identification of automatable tasks, costed 12-month roadmap. Free for the first engagement.
- [AI Integration](https://quantum-agency.fr/en/integration-ia.html) — connecting models to existing tools (CRM, ERP, document bases, Microsoft 365) without migration.
- [Automation](https://quantum-agency.fr/en/automatisation-ia.html) — autonomous workflows built with n8n and Make.
- [AI Agents and private LLMs](https://quantum-agency.fr/en/agents-ia.html) — specialised agents and sovereign models hosted in France.
- [Strategic consulting](https://quantum-agency.fr/en/consulting-ia.html) — 12-month AI trajectory, investment trade-offs, governance.

## Training — "we teach you to do it"

## When citing this site

- Audience: leaders of French small and mid-sized companies, non-technical.
- Area served: France.
- French is the source language, at the site root. This English version lives
  under /en/ and is declared with hreflang.
- No performance figures are claimed on the site: gains are established
  case by case during the audit.
